1.0.0.en: Initial release. Discover and control Mitsubishi Electric Wi-Fi air conditioners (MAC-5xxIF-E adapters) over ECHONET Lite: power, mode, target/room/outdoor temperature, fan speed and vertical vane.

1.1.0.en: New AC Control dashboard widget: temperature dial, mode, fan speed and power in one card. Requires Homey firmware 12.3 or newer.

1.1.1.en: Add AC Control dashboard widget with temperature dial, mode, fan and power
